It's a brand new start for the Operation Repo team when Lou bets big on a high-risk opportunity .
The team is ahead of schedule on their Vegas mission, but will it all be derailed?
An Elvis impersonator gets Matt and Ronnie all shook up, and a ventriloquist's dummy has a nasty attitude.
Fuming over Froy's departure, Matt loses his temper on a dominatrix and her client.
The team returns from a successful mission in Vegas, but there's trouble brewing within the crew's ranks.

The team wonders what's up with Sonia as she wrestles with Lou's big secret.
Lou has retired, making Sonia the new boss, but will she be able to keep the company going?
Sonia pushes the company to repossess more than just cars, and the backlash threatens to end her time.
Sonia is still struggling to keep the team in line.
Carlos goes undercover at a frat house, but when the party gets the best of him Sonia has to step in.
Matt is eager to work his way onto Sonia's coveted airplane repo, despite her adamancy against him.
On this special season finale of Operation Repo, the team gears up for a mile high repo of a lifetime!
In this Operation Repo, the team must recover an airplane and return one-hundred thousand dollars.
Froy and Sonia encounter a city employee who tries to give them the boot.
